positive_snippets: Had a 2 week stay. Rooms are well maintained. Neat and tidy. Have smart tv in each rooms. Wifi is present. Washrooms are clean. Water supply is present 24 hours. There is also geyser if u need hot water. Room service is good. Food was great, neatly packed and served on time. Thanking all the staff and wishing them all the best. Keep up your good work

Very worst experience is bed which is old and completely worn out.

My worst experience till date is the hotel room condition is very bad, no any amenities ,staff behaviour was third class all over my suggestion don't stay in this third class hotel.

Look at the dilapidated wall in the room. There was no ventilation. They claim that it’s smoke free property but butts of cigarettes were found in the washroom. Rooms are small. And have a weird smell to it . The floor is uneven and mould is growing everywhere be it washroom or walls. Bad decision
